title: Vermont Health Platform: Technical Progress and Architecture Baseline
summary: A technical post-mortem and progress report on the VHP GitHub repository. This document outlines the migration to Next.js 15 and the successful synchronization of the Sanity Content Lake with the ADS data standards.

children.text: The Vermont Health Platform (VHP) has reached a stabilized 'Golden State.' By decoupling the frontend from the schema-driven backend, we have established a framework for rapid policy dissemination.

body.title: Tech Deep Dive: Schema Sync
body.summary: A CTO-level breakdown of how the 'fxz10xl7' project ID was locked and the schema was pushed to production.

children.text: Consistency in the Project ID is the bedrock of data liquidity. Without it, we are just shouting into a digital void.
